maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from consumer app subscriptions (XTRA, Unlimited) and advertising, not repair or servicing of installed products.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers via subscriptions and in-app purchases, plus private advertisers; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by expanding its own app, subscribers and new features; not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer social/dating app; users can easily switch to or use alternative apps, with little cost beyond losing network.
